# High Court Chariot (Rosa trait)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Skills affected:** High Court Chariot
- **Mechanic tags:** hero-trait, defense

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. Rosa trait #1: No Guard debuff, Block Ratio (base 30% / cap 60–80%), Enemy Count weighting, Holy Domain slot. Barrier + player No-Guard deferred.

## Implementation (engine model)

Modeled in `high_court_chariot.py::apply`; the base node can be disabled independently (`_enabled(slot_levels, 0)`) while the trait stays selected. Base emits `attack_block_chance_inc` + `spell_block_chance_inc` +0.30, and (inside domain) `dmg_additional` = `_INSIDE_ADDITIONAL` [0.20..0.44] by tier. Conditions: `inside_holy_domain` (default ON), `murderous_intent` (0-100, default 100), `enemies_in_holy_domain` (default 1), `improvision_active`. "Per enemy" lines use weighted count = enemies × `enemy_count_weight` (defaults to `offense.TARGET_ENEMY_COUNT_WEIGHT`, Boss ×5). Picks: Unbreakable Stand (L45) `dmg_additional = min(per×weighted, 1.00)`; Whirlwind Advance (L45) `movement_speed_inc`; Invulnerability (L60) `block_ratio_inc` + `block_ratio_upper_limit_flat`; Divine Intervention (L60) `dmg_additional = _DIVINE_PER_MI × mi`; Improvision (L75) `dmg_additional` at cap `_IMPROVISION_CAP`. Desperation (L75) computes No Guard: `no_guard_dmg_taken = 0.10 × (1 + stacks_inc) × (1 + block_ratio% × _DESPERATION_NOGUARD_PER_BR)`, where `stacks_inc = _stacks_lost_inc(2 + max_channeled_stacks_flat)` and `block_ratio` comes from `stash` via `defense.block_ratio_value` (base 0.30). Limitations/NYI: player self No Guard emitted as `no_guard_self_dmg_taken` but the defense engine does not yet consume it; Murderous-Intent regen/restore and Holy-Domain radius are informational only.
